transformations: This original expected-only plan contains no capture and therefore required no value replacement.

expectedObservations: All four stages should independently pass the EX11 CPU-reference and tolerance contract on every declared fixture before collection begins.

The canonical, warp-tail, and reassociated paths should follow declared sizes 16777219 -> 32769 -> 65 -> 1, while four-load staging should follow 16777219 -> 16385 -> 17 -> 1; these are source-derived expectations, not observed traffic.
Each stage should retain three excluded warm-up attempts and ten fresh attempts with checked completion, raw-sample custody, a predeclared median, minimum, and maximum, and no sample deletion.
Exact-GPU version and availability queries, permission, filtering, replay, report custody, and a complete Environment Manifest should either qualify the profiler record or produce a retained blocker.
A matching block-barrier or tail shared-partial field should be lower for warp-tail-control than canonical-shared-tree; unchanged or higher evidence should reject the synchronization mechanism.

The reassociated final scalar bits are predicted to differ while remaining within tolerance, and an available owner-defined divergence field is predicted to be higher for periodic masks; equal bits or an equal-or-lower divergence value should reject the corresponding hypothesis.
A matching partial-array traffic field should be lower for four-load-staging than reassociated-warp-order; equal or higher evidence should reject the traffic mechanism.

Every interpretation should remain limited to its named mechanism and disclose numerical order, instruction mix, shared traffic, resources, cache, clocks, replay, and system load as applicable competing explanations.
